summary: Iteration 42: Tested server-side swipe limits, extra_swipes ad reward caps, rewarded 'See who liked you' reveal (backend + frontend). Backend 13/13 functional tests pass. One concurrency bug found: /api/ads/reward overwrites extra_swipes with a read-then-$set, so parallel rewards (or a swipe made while the reward is being processed) lose updates. Frontend: on the Likes page, locked cards show Watch Ad + Unlock; Watch Ad (simulated on web) calls reveal, the card unblurs showing 'Kavya0, 23', and it stays revealed after reload; Like on a revealed card goes to /premium; Unlock goes to /premium. Discover page overwrites the faked localStorage (999 extra) with the server value (0); at 50 used, a pass returns 429 and the 'Swipes Khatam' modal opens; Watch Ad gives +10 (toast) and the next pass uses one extra (server shows 9). No page errors.

minor.issue: Lost update: extra_swipes is computed from a stale user read and then $set. 15 parallel requests: 5 returned 200 (cap held), but extra_swipes=30 instead of 50. It also wipes any _consume_swipe $inc:-1 that happens during the request, so the user gets those swipes back. Fix: use {'$inc': {'extra_swipes': amount}} (same for priority_messages).

The daily cap is check-then-insert (count_documents, then insert), so very fast concurrent calls could go over it. The cap held in the test (reveal: exactly 3/8 succeeded). The endpoints have no auth/SSV, so any client can claim rewards for any user_id without watching an ad. This is limited by the 5/day and 3/day caps.
Premium response now includes 'revealed': false on every item (small schema change, harmless).

integration_issues.issue: The card advances optimistically before the API 429 comes back, so the profile the user swiped is skipped without being recorded (it reappears later). Minor UX issue.
Pass now uses up a swipe; at 0 swipes the API returns 429, but the card is already removed optimistically and no error is shown.
onReward(async) is not awaited, so the revealingId/showingAd spinner clears before the reveal/reward API finishes. Cosmetic.

action_items: routes/ads.py track_ad_reward: replace the read-modify-$set of extra_swipes (and priority_messages) with an atomic $inc
Optional: make the daily caps atomic (e.g. a per-day counter on the user doc with a conditional $inc) and add auth to /ads/reward and /likes/{id}/reveal
Optional: on a 429 in Discover/Likes, put the optimistically removed card back
critical_code_review_comments: reveal_like_with_ad does not exclude likes where user2_action == 'pass' (get_likes hides those), so a user can reveal someone they already passed on and use up a reveal.
server.py is 12.5k lines and should be split up.
